title: Contains Duplicate
hint: A set gives O(1) membership checks. Target: O(n) time, O(n) space.

title: Two Sum
hint: Store each value's index in a dict and look for target - n before adding n. O(n) time.

title: Valid Anagram
hint: Compare letter counts with a dict or Counter. O(n) time.

title: Group Anagrams
hint: Anagrams share a key: the sorted string, or a tuple of 26 letter counts. The tuple avoids the sort, giving O(n*k).

title: Top K Frequent Elements
hint: Bucket values by their count, then read buckets from highest to lowest for O(n).

title: Encode and Decode Strings
hint: Prefix each string with its length and a marker, such as 5#hello.

title: Product of Array Except Self
hint: Multiply a running product from the left into each slot, then one from the right.

title: Valid Sudoku
hint: Keep a set for each row, column and box. The box index is (r // 3, c // 3).

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
hint: Put values in a set. Only start counting from n when n - 1 isn't in the set.

title: Valid Palindrome
hint: Move two pointers inward, skipping non-alphanumerics. O(1) extra space is possible.

title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted
hint: Sum too small: move left up. Too big: move right down.

title: Container With Most Water
hint: Start at both ends and always move the shorter bar. Moving the taller one can never help.

title: 3Sum
hint: Sort, fix the first value, and run two pointers on the rest. Skip repeated values.

title: Trapping Rain Water
hint: Water above a bar is min(tallest on left, tallest on right) - its height. Two pointers do it in O(1) space.

title: Best Time to Buy And Sell Stock
hint: Track the lowest price so far and the best profit if you sold today. One pass.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
hint: Sliding window. Remember each character's last index and jump the left edge past a repeat, but never backwards.

title: Permutation In String
hint: Fixed-size window the length of s1. Compare letter counts as it slides, 26 entries at most.

title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
hint: A window is valid when its length minus the count of its most common letter is at most k.

title: Minimum Window Substring
hint: Grow the right edge until every requirement is met, then shrink the left edge as far as possible.

title: Sliding Window Maximum
hint: Keep a deque of indices with decreasing values. The front is the current maximum.

title: Binary Search
hint: Use while l <= r, and move to m + 1 or m - 1 so the range always shrinks.

title: Koko Eating Bananas
hint: Binary search on the answer k between 1 and max(piles). Hours needed = sum of ceil(pile / k).

title: Search In Rotated Sorted Array
hint: At least one side of mid is always sorted. Check whether target falls inside that side.

title: Search a 2D Matrix
hint: Treat it as one sorted array: index i maps to matrix[i // cols][i % cols].

title: Find Minimum In Rotated Sorted Array
hint: Compare the middle with the right end. That tells you which half holds the minimum.

title: Time Based Key Value Store
hint: Store a list of (time, value) per key, and use binary search in get.

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
hint: Binary search the partition of the shorter array so everything on the left is <= everything on the right.

title: Reverse Linked List
hint: Keep prev and cur. Save cur.next before you overwrite it. O(1) extra space.

title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
hint: A dummy head removes the special case for the first node. Attach whatever is left at the end.

title: Linked List Cycle
hint: Floyd's slow and fast pointers: if there's a loop, fast eventually laps slow.

title: Reorder List
hint: Find the middle, reverse the second half, then weave the two halves together.

title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
hint: A dummy node plus two pointers n apart finds the node before the one to remove.

title: Copy List With Random Pointer
hint: Map each original node to its copy, then fill in the pointers in a second pass.

title: Add Two Numbers
hint: Walk both lists with a carry, and keep going while anything is left.

title: Find The Duplicate Number
hint: Treat each value as a next pointer. It forms a linked list with a cycle, so use Floyd's algorithm.

title: LRU Cache
hint: A dict plus a doubly linked list works. In Python, collections.OrderedDict also does the job.

title: Merge K Sorted Lists
hint: A min-heap of the current front nodes gives O(n log k). Add a tie-breaker, since nodes can't be compared.

title: Reverse Nodes In K Group
hint: Check that k nodes exist, reverse them, reconnect, and move on. A dummy head helps.

title: Valid Parentheses
hint: Push openers and pop on each closer. The stack must end empty.

title: Min Stack
hint: Store the minimum so far next to each value, either in tuples or a second stack.

title: Daily Temperatures
hint: Monotonic decreasing stack of indices. A warmer day resolves everything colder on the stack.

title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
hint: Push numbers on a stack. On an operator, pop two values. The second one popped is the left operand. int(a / b) truncates toward zero.

title: Car Fleet
hint: Sort by position, closest to target first, and compare arrival times.

title: Largest Rectangle In Histogram
hint: Use a stack of increasing heights. When a bar is lower, pop and compute each popped bar's widest rectangle.

title: Invert Binary Tree
hint: Swap the children at each node, then recurse.

title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
hint: 1 + the deeper of the two subtrees. An empty tree has depth 0.

title: Diameter of Binary Tree
hint: At each node, the best path through it is left height + right height.

title: Balanced Binary Tree
hint: Compute heights bottom-up and report failure as soon as one node is unbalanced.

title: Same Tree
hint: Recurse on both trees together. Two Nones match.

title: Subtree of Another Tree
hint: At each node of root, run a same-tree check against subRoot.

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
hint: BFS with a deque. len(q) at the start of each loop is the size of that level.

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree
hint: Walk down from the root. If both values are smaller go left, if both are larger go right, otherwise you've found it.

title: Binary Tree Right Side View
hint: BFS by level and keep the last value of each one.

title: Count Good Nodes In Binary Tree
hint: DFS, passing down the largest value seen so far.

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
hint: Pass down an allowed (low, high) range. Comparing only with direct children isn't enough.

title: Kth Smallest Element In a BST
hint: An in-order traversal visits values in sorted order. Stop at the kth.

title: Construct Binary Tree From Preorder And Inorder Traversal
hint: The first preorder value is the root. Its position in inorder splits left from right. A dict of positions makes it O(n).

title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
hint: Each node returns its best downward path, ignoring negative branches, and updates the answer with both branches.

title: Serialize And Deserialize Binary Tree
hint: Write a preorder traversal with a marker for missing children, then read it back in the same order.

title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
hint: Each node is a map from character to child, plus an end-of-word flag.

title: Design Add And Search Words Data Structure
hint: A trie plus DFS. On '.', try every child.

title: Word Search II
hint: Build a trie of the words, then DFS from each cell while following the trie.

title: Subsets
hint: At each index choose to include or skip. Remember to append a copy of cur, not cur itself.

title: Combination Sum
hint: Recurse from index i, not i + 1, so a value can repeat. Never go back to earlier indices, which avoids duplicates.

title: Generate Parentheses
hint: Add '(' while opened < n. Add ')' only while closed < opened.

title: Combination Sum II
hint: Sort first. At each depth, skip a value equal to the one just tried.

title: Permutations
hint: Build the result by choosing any unused value at each position.

title: Subsets II
hint: Sort, then at each depth skip a value equal to the previous one tried.

title: Word Search
hint: DFS from each cell. Mark a cell while it's on the path, then restore it on the way back.

title: Palindrome Partitioning
hint: At each start, try every prefix that is a palindrome and recurse on the rest.

title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
hint: Extend each partial string with each letter of the next digit.

title: N Queens
hint: Place one queen per row. Track used columns and both diagonals (r + c and r - c) in sets.

title: Kth Largest Element In a Stream
hint: Keep a min-heap of the k largest. Its smallest element is the answer.

title: Last Stone Weight
hint: heapq is a min-heap, so store negated values to get a max-heap.

title: K Closest Points to Origin
hint: Compare squared distances, no sqrt needed. A max-heap of size k gives O(n log k).

title: Kth Largest Element In An Array
hint: A min-heap of size k gives O(n log k).

title: Task Scheduler
hint: The most frequent task sets the frame: (max_count - 1) * (n + 1) + how many tasks share that count. The answer is at least len(tasks).

title: Design Twitter
hint: Give each tweet a rising time counter, and merge the latest tweets of each followed user with a heap.

title: Find Median From Data Stream
hint: Use a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half, and keep them balanced.

title: Number of Islands
hint: Scan the grid. Each unvisited '1' is a new island, so flood-fill it with DFS or BFS.

title: Clone Graph
hint: A dict from original to copy, filled in before you recurse, stops you looping around cycles.

title: Rotting Oranges
hint: Multi-source BFS: start with every rotten orange in the queue, and count fresh ones as they turn.

title: Max Area of Island
hint: Flood-fill each island and count the cells.

title: Walls And Gates
hint: Run one BFS that starts from every gate at once.

title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
hint: Search uphill from each ocean's edges, then intersect the two visited sets.

title: Surrounded Regions
hint: Mark every "O" reachable from the edge as safe. Everything else gets captured.

title: Course Schedule
hint: You can finish unless the prerequisite graph has a cycle. Use DFS with three states, or Kahn's algorithm.

title: Course Schedule II
hint: Topological sort: repeatedly take courses with no remaining prerequisites.

title: Graph Valid Tree
hint: A tree has exactly n - 1 edges. Then you only need to check that every node is connected.

title: Number of Connected Components In An Undirected Graph
hint: Union-find: start with n groups and subtract one for each merge.

title: Redundant Connection
hint: Union-find: the first edge joining two already connected nodes is the answer.

title: Word Ladder
hint: BFS over words. Patterns like h*t let you find neighbors quickly.

title: Climbing Stairs
hint: ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2), and two variables are enough. The n = 40 test will time out without memoization.

title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
hint: The cost to reach a stair is the cheaper of the two ways into it.

title: House Robber
hint: best(i) = max(best(i-1), best(i-2) + nums[i]).

title: Longest Palindromic Substring
hint: Expand around every center, both single characters and gaps between them. O(n^2) time, O(1) space.

title: House Robber II
hint: Solve the line twice: once without the first house and once without the last.

title: Palindromic Substrings
hint: Expand around every center, both single characters and gaps.

title: Decode Ways
hint: ways(i) = ways(i-1) if the digit is valid, plus ways(i-2) if the last two digits form 10 to 26.

title: Coin Change
hint: best[x] = 1 + the smallest best[x - coin] over all coins.

title: Maximum Product Subarray
hint: Track both the largest and smallest product ending here, because a negative can flip them.

title: Word Break
hint: ok[i] is True if some word ends at i and ok holds at its start.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
hint: O(n^2) DP works. Keeping the smallest tail for each length with bisect gives O(n log n).

title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
hint: Look for a subset that adds up to half the total. A set of reachable sums is enough.

title: Maximum Subarray
hint: Kadane: drop the running sum as soon as starting fresh is better. Don't assume the answer is at least 0.

title: Jump Game
hint: Track the furthest reachable index. Fail if you ever stand beyond it.

title: Jump Game II
hint: Think of BFS levels. When i reaches the end of the current jump's range, take a jump and extend to the furthest seen.

title: Gas Station
hint: If total gas is at least total cost, an answer exists. Restart after any point where the tank goes negative.

title: Hand of Straights
hint: Always start a group from the smallest remaining card.

title: Merge Triplets to Form Target Triplet
hint: Ignore any triplet with a value above target. Then check whether the rest can reach every position.

title: Partition Labels
hint: Note each letter's last position. Extend the piece to that point, and close it when you reach it.

title: Valid Parenthesis String
hint: Track the lowest and highest possible count of open brackets as you go.

title: Happy Number
hint: Track seen values in a set, or use slow and fast pointers.

title: Plus One
hint: Walk from the right. A 9 becomes 0 and the carry continues.

title: Multiply Strings
hint: Digits at positions i and j land in position i + j, counted from the right. Carry as you go and strip leading zeros.

title: Rotate Image
hint: Reverse the rows, then swap across the main diagonal.

title: Spiral Matrix
hint: Shrink top, bottom, left and right bounds as you finish each side.

title: Set Matrix Zeroes
hint: Note the rows and columns to clear first. For O(1) space, store those marks in the first row and column.

title: Pow(x, n)
hint: Square x and halve n. For a negative n, use 1 / x and -n.

title: Detect Squares
hint: Treat each stored point on a shared diagonal as the opposite corner, and multiply the counts of the other two corners.

title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
hint: This is a minimum spanning tree. Prim's algorithm with a heap works well.

title: Network Delay Time
hint: Dijkstra from k. The answer is the largest shortest distance.

title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
hint: Bellman-Ford: run k + 1 rounds, working from a copy of the previous round's prices.

title: Reconstruct Itinerary
hint: Hierholzer's algorithm: visit destinations in sorted order and add an airport after its edges are used up, then reverse.

title: Swim In Rising Water
hint: Dijkstra where a path's cost is the highest cell on it.

title: Alien Dictionary
hint: Compare neighboring words to get letter edges, then topologically sort. A longer word before its own prefix is invalid.

title: Unique Paths
hint: Paths to a cell = paths from above + paths from the left. One row of DP is enough.

title: Longest Common Subsequence
hint: If the characters match, add 1 to the diagonal. Otherwise take the better of dropping a character from either string.

title: Best Time to Buy And Sell Stock With Cooldown
hint: Track three states per day: holding, just sold and resting.

title: Coin Change II
hint: Loop over coins on the outside, so each combination is counted only once.

title: Target Sum
hint: Keep a dict from each reachable sum to how many ways reach it.

title: Interleaving String
hint: ok[i][j] asks whether the first i of s1 and first j of s2 can form the first i + j of s3.

title: Edit Distance
hint: On a mismatch, take 1 + the smallest of insert, delete and replace. On a match, use the diagonal.

title: Longest Increasing Path In a Matrix
hint: DFS with memoization. Increasing paths can't form cycles.

title: Distinct Subsequences
hint: For each character of s, loop j backward and add ways[j - 1] to ways[j] on a match.

title: Burst Balloons
hint: Interval DP: choose which balloon in a range is burst last. Its neighbors are then the range's edges.

title: Regular Expression Matching
hint: Recursion with memoization: handle whether the next pattern character is followed by *.

title: Meeting Rooms
hint: Sort by start and compare each meeting with the next.

title: Insert Interval
hint: Copy intervals that end before it, merge those that overlap, then copy the rest.

title: Merge Intervals
hint: Sort by start, then extend the last merged interval or start a new one.

title: Non Overlapping Intervals
hint: Sort by end time and keep whatever finishes earliest.

title: Meeting Rooms II
hint: Sort starts and ends separately and sweep through them, or use a heap of end times.

title: Minimum Interval to Include Each Query
hint: Process queries in sorted order with a min-heap of (size, right) for intervals that have started.

title: Single Number
hint: XOR cancels pairs.

title: Number of 1 Bits
hint: n & (n - 1) clears the lowest set bit.

title: Counting Bits
hint: bits[i] = bits[i >> 1] + (i & 1).

title: Reverse Bits
hint: Loop 32 times, shifting the result left and taking the lowest bit of n.

title: Missing Number
hint: XOR all indices and values, or subtract the sum from the expected total.

title: Sum of Two Integers
hint: XOR adds without carrying, and (a & b) << 1 is the carry. Mask to 32 bits and convert back at the end.

title: Reverse Integer
hint: Work on the absolute value and check the range at the end.
